official: 港区乳児等通園支援事業の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 議案一覧

name: 乳児等通園支援事業所の基準を変更
summary: 現在、乳児等通園支援事業の設備や運営に関する基準を条例で定めています。この議案では、運営規程に定める内容や、設備・職員の基準の適用などを改めます。改正は令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 運営規程に定める利用定員から、乳児・幼児別の区分をなくす
利用定員を、子ども・子育て支援法に基づく確認で定める定員として明確にする
特例保育を行う事業者が同じ事業所で一般型を行う場合、設備・職員の基準を適用しない
条例中の用語や、運営規程に定める事項を改める
who: 乳児等通園支援事業所
特例保育を行う事業者
why: 国の基準改正を踏まえ、運営規程に関する基準などを変更するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes standards for infant and young child attendance support services
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Facilities and Operation of Minato City Infant and Other Child Attendance Support Services
en.summary: The standards for the facilities and operation of infant and other child attendance support services are currently set by ordinance. This bill revises the required contents of operating regulations and how standards for facilities and staff apply. The amendments take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Removes the separate capacity categories for infants and young children from the capacity set out in operating regulations
Clarifies that the capacity is the one set through confirmation under the Act on Child and Child-Rearing Support
Exempts providers offering special-case childcare from facility and staff standards when they also offer the general type at the same facility
Revises terms in the ordinance and the matters to be included in operating regulations
who: Infant and other child attendance support service facilities
en.why: The ward says the changes are being made to revise standards concerning operating regulations and other matters in light of amendments to national standards.
